title: Ekman Boundary Layers Under Transport Noise
summary: We consider a 3D rotating Navier-Stokes equation with transport-stretching noise, posed between two horizontal plates, and study the joint limit of vanishing vertical viscosity and rapid rotation. Our driving noise depends only on the horizontal coordinates and its vertical component vanishes with the viscosity. Provided that the initial data is purely horizontal, we construct martingale weak solutions which converge in $L^2_ωL^\infty_tL^2_x$ to the layered strong solution of a 2D stochastic Navier-Stokes equation with damping.
